intro_questions: What is the primary function of the landing gear?
Name two basic design requirements for landing gear.
List the three main types of landing gear configurations.

Basic design requirements of landing gear
Shock absorption mechanisms

Gear door operation and sealing
Maintenance access points

Describe the role of shock absorbers in landing gear design.
Identify the function of the nose gear in a tricycle configuration.
